text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with 
Silence Suzuka, we stopped by the shopping 
district. And then—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...It's getting rather crowded.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah, the lottery... That explains it.

"Come to think of it, I think I got a 
lottery ticket when I went shopping 
earlier."
choice_data_list:
You've got a raffle ticket, so go give it 
a draw!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
“But you're the one who has the raffle 
tickets, Trainer, so—”
(Clatter, clatter!)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, 1st Prize: 'Special Deluxe Carrot 
Hamburg Steak'! Congraaaatulations!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh? That bell chiming...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it feels a little nostalgic somehow.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Umm... when I was a child, I used to run 
in small races held in my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"It was a really tiny meet called the 
"Chibikko Race," so they didn't even have 
a finish line post—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When I crossed the finish line, the 
attendant rang the bell for me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Just... like that.
choice_data_list:
Then let's take 1st place and have them 
ring it for us!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, 1st place? Did you mean 1st 
prize...?
choice_data_list: To hear the sound of the bell!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I see.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well then, may I? I'll go ahead and draw.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ...I'll go claim 1st 
place for us.

Full of enthusiasm, Silence Suzuka pulled 
the raffle wheel lever!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, something above 1st place...!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san, how would this play out 
in an actual race?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: A new track record...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that sounds nice too.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But... I wonder how I'm supposed to use a 
hot spring trip voucher.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Going on a trip... The only times I've 
ever done that were with my family...
choice_data_list: How about inviting your friends along?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Friends... you say?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, who should I invite...? A trip is a 
big deal, after all...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Mmm……
choice_data_list: There's no need to decide right away.
There's no need to decide right away.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That's true. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If it's alright, Trainer, would you hold 
onto this hot spring trip voucher for me?
choice_data_list: Want me to hold onto it for you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I can't decide right away, and 
holding onto it would just weigh on my 
mind...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Once I decide what to do, I'll come pick 
it up. ...Thank you very much.

At Silence Suzuka's request, I decided to 
hold onto the hot spring trip ticket for 
her.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh my, 1st place... hehe!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Getting 1st place, even if it's just in a 
lottery... really makes you happy, doesn't 
it?
choice_data_list:
The hamburger steak looks delicious too, 
huh

The hamburger steak looks delicious too, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... True enough.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Still, with dorm meals too, this might be 
a bit much... Trainer, would you like to 
split it in half?"

I decided to split the acquired hamburg 
steak in half with Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: 2nd place... Just a little more.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's an incredible amount of 
carrots..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What should we do with this much?
choice_data_list:
Why not share it with everyone at the 
dorm?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... That sounds good. I'll do that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Spe-chan would be thrilled if she 
saw this...

I carried carrots back to the dormitory 
together with Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: T-Third place... huh.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer... It seems luck was 
not on my side...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should have asked Fukukitaru to 
cast a good luck charm for me...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Apparently there's a good luck charm you 
do before drawing a fortune...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure how effective it will be, 
but...

Putting the 3rd-prize carrot into my 
shopping bag, I headed home while gazing 
at the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No way...! Not even in the top three...?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No, a result like this is unacceptable...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we need to hurry up and train...!
choice_data_list: It's okay, it's just a raffle!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... R-Right, of course...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... I'm sorry, it seems I got a 
little too carried away..."

I watched the setting sun alongside a 
disappointed Silence Suzuka on our way 
home...
